status: frozen implementation policy before any genuine returns; engineering review required before historical use

unchanged.parameters: all original lookbacks, ranks, filters, 5 stocks, 2 per sector, 10% per name, 50% gross, whole shares
unchanged.candidate_adapter: blocked; requires separately reviewed version-specific recomputation from account state

execution_policy.decision_at: 08:00 America/New_York first next exchange session; each month boundary must contain model evidence
execution_policy.equity: actual prior-close economic NAV including sale receivables and dividend entitlements; floor USD NAV to integer cents only at model budget boundary
execution_policy.positions: actual prior economic quantities by permanent security ID; no caller-supplied signal/equity/holdings overrides
execution_policy.price_precision: USD Decimal text, up to 6 source decimals; 60-digit HALF_EVEN arithmetic isolated from caller context; original baseline retains own 50-digit arithmetic
execution_policy.cash_rounding: once per order: buy gross ceil to cents, sale gross floor to cents, then integer fee; dividend aggregate entitlement per account/event HALF_UP to cents only at cash credit
execution_policy.quotes: raw USD bid/ask snapshot observed <= available <= open, age <=60 seconds; explicit additional slippage, no second half-spread field
execution_policy.open_quantity_policy: price-contingent next-open sizing remains idealized, not pre-open MOO execution evidence
execution_policy.gap_and_caps: min(frozen prior budget, 10% conservative post-cost NAV lower bound); reserve worst-case liquidation plus target repurchase costs; fees included in share budget; check actual post-cost 10%/50% exposure; caps are rebalance-time, not continuous
execution_policy.funding: all purchases paid immediately from settled cash; sale proceeds held unsettled; no borrowing or reuse of same-day sales; maximum affordable partial whole-share buys in sorted permanent-ID order, logged; no intramonth retries
execution_policy.settlement: regular-way US common stocks: T+3 in supported 2000..2017-09-04 range, T+2 from 2017-09-05, T+1 from 2024-05-28; separate externally audited settlement-business calendar; cash usable first processed checkpoint on/after due date; no settlement failures assumed
execution_policy.dividends: ordinary USD cash only, <25% prior closing price, no due bills; prior-session economic holdings fixed before ex-date open trades; exact receivable then payable cash at explicit supplied credit timestamp; no automatic reinvestment
execution_policy.payable_timestamp: explicit scenario cash-credit timestamp, not inferred from a date alone; verify broker/source timing or register conservative timing before real evaluation
execution_policy.events: whole-share splits/reverse splits and explicit same-permanent-ID renames supported; one event per security per session; reject unsupported mergers, delistings, spinoffs, due bills, combined events and fractional entitlements
execution_policy.liquidity: 1% prior 20-session consolidated mean volume, split-normalized to prior-close share units (floor mean), then adjusted for current-open split; also require displayed size; source authenticity not established
execution_policy.failure: no missing monthly decisions/dates/held marks; unavailable execution, incomplete evidence or unsupported event invalidates whole study; never skip failed securities or dates
execution_policy.marking: future close marks passed only to close bookkeeping, never to open planner; later decisions reconcile latest mark and model prices plus all economic actions since account origin within model coverage

cost_scenarios: original 5bp half-spread plus 10bp slippage and sensitivity values unchanged; normalize assumed half-spread into synthetic/proxy bid/ask upstream with provenance, or use actual bid/ask without adding a second spread; no real source adapter included
